messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Increased 5xx rate for Private VPC ILB traffic in europe-west1. Trigger: ILB backend 502 spike > 15% over 5m. Paging alice.sre (oncall)

alice.sre: got it. pulling up dashboards now. any customer reports yet?

dave.support: I have 3 active tickets from customers in EU reporting timeouts and 502s for private endpoints. CS notified.

alice.sre: initial hypothesis: ILB -> auth-proxy (third-party) is returning 502s intermittently. checking logs.

bob.infra: seeing a correlation with recent GCP control-plane errors in eu-west1 for internal-lb health checks — forwarding gcp status link: https://status.cloud.google.com/incidents/abcd (watching)

gcp-status-bot: GCP Incident 2026-03-15T09:25Z: Internal Load Balancer health-checks impacted in europe-west1. Root cause under investigation.

alice.sre: ok, mitigation plan options: 1) route affected customers to eu-west4 fallback regional ILB (if config exists) 2) temporarily change health-check path to bypass auth-proxy for internal checks 3) open immediate support case with auth-proxy vendor. I'm going to step through 2 first (least blast radius).

carla.platform: +1 for 2 while we validate. We should coordinate with product to avoid exposing any unintended endpoints.

bob.infra: command to patch health check to /_probe (bypass auth) is here: ```bash
# update health check to simple 200 endpoint
gcloud compute health-checks update http ilb-health-eu --port 8080 --request-path="/_probe" --region=europe-west1
```
I can run but need approval from platform.

carla.platform: please run, alice and I will verify listener config and ensure firewall allows it.

alice.sre: run it, bob. I will monitor. also enabling enhanced logging for backend services.

bob.infra: running now...

bob.infra: (output) PATCH OK. health-check path updated.

alice.sre: dashboards: 502 rate dropping from 22% -> 6% over last 3m. Latency still slightly elevated but errors trending down. Nice work.

dave.support: update sent to affected customers: "We're investigating increased 502 errors for private endpoints in europe-west1. We applied a temporary health-check bypass which has reduced errors. We'll post follow-up when root cause identified."

eve.csm: FYI several enterprise customers asked for impact window and scope — can we confirm which tenants were routed through the auth-proxy vs bypass?

alice.sre: quick customer-impact assessment: approx 7 dedicated Private VPC customers in eu-west1 impacted, ~10% of their requests failing peak, no data loss, requests retried by SDKs succeeded ~60% of the time. Formal RCA will quantify further.

obs-vendor-bot: Notice: upstream tracing service (third-party) in eu-west region showing elevated ingest latency and dropped spans. Might affect our anomaly detection but not core HTTP paths (info only).

alice.sre: opening joint support tickets: 1) GCP ILB health-check incident tracked with GCP (we linked), 2) auth-proxy vendor ticket for 502s on auth token exchange, 3) observability vendor ticket for dropped traces.

carla.platform: also enabling fallback routing policy for Private customers: route policy set to prefer regionally-local model (eu-west4) when eu-west1 ILB shows >10% errors. I'm going to apply a canary to a single low-impact customer before a full shift.

bob.infra: applied routing override for customer-red-canary -> now traffic to eu-west4. verifying connection...

alice.sre: canary looks healthy, 200s now. escalating plan: keep health-check bypass in place until auth-proxy vendor provides patch or GCP resolves control-plane flakiness.

gcp-status-bot: Update: GCP internal control-plane errors mitigated in europe-west1, but follow-up investigations ongoing.

auth-proxy-vendor: (via email) We reproduced a token-exchange race under certain control-plane reconfiguration events. Patch v1.2.3-pre will be available in 2 hours. Recommend health-check bypass meanwhile.

alice.sre: thanks. schedule: patch once vendor releases and we've validated in staging. Until then keep bypass and routing fallback as protection.

dave.support: creating consolidated incident notice for customers + status page update. Draft: "We experienced increased 502 errors for Private VPC customers in europe-west1 due to a combination of GCP ILB health-check anomalies and a token-exchange issue in our auth-proxy vendor. We applied mitigations (health-check bypass + regional routing fallback). Service levels restored for most customers; some saw transient errors. Next update in 2 hours or when vendor patching completes." Approve?

eve.csm: approve. add contact for enterprise customers to request an extended post-incident review.

alice.sre: approved. please post to status and send to affected CS owners.

carla.platform: we need to capture the mitigation commands and timelines in the incident doc. I'll own the playbook update to include an explicit health-check bypass step and routing fallback recipe.

alice.sre: I'm going to request handoff to the night SRE at 18:00 UTC. @bob.infra and @carla.platform please be on-call for follow-ups during patch rollout. I'll summarize current state:
- initial spike at 09:21 UTC (thread_ts)
- health-check bypass applied 09:36 UTC -> errors down to ~6%
- routing fallback canary started 09:45 UTC -> canary healthy
- vendor patch ETA ~2 hours from now
- impact: 7 customers, ~10% failure at peak, no data loss

alice.sre: handing off to @bob.infra for night coverage at 18:00 UTC. please update thread with any further escalations.

bob.infra: taking handoff. I'll update the incident doc and set a reminder to validate vendor patch deployment. If GCP flakiness returns, we'll revert to fallback routing.

obs-vendor-bot: Vendor Response: Observability ingest issues resolved, no long-term impact to logs or metrics; some traces lost (sampling).

alice.sre: final note: postmortem owner: carla.platform. please coordinate with customer success and infra for root cause and follow-ups. I'll mark incident as "mitigated" in the tracker but keep thread open until vendor patch and verification.

carla.platform: acknowledged, I'll start the RCA doc and capture timelines + customer impact details.

incident-bot: Incident 1779001123 status: MITIGATED -> monitoring. Handoff recorded to bob.infra.

alice.sre: thanks everyone. great cross-team coordination. :heart:
